verdict.rationale: Brevo's MCP evidence is server-side only: it describes AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude connecting to Brevo. Nothing shows Brevo, or its Aura AI assistant, acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. The axis is plausible for a SaaS platform with built-in AI, so absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
